title: feat(app-shell): the locked permission matrix offers Clone to customize through the published clone_permission_set action (objectui#5987)
body:
Fixes #5987
Clause-②: no

Placeholders in this body are written as capitalised words (NAME, PR_NUMBER) rather than in angle brackets, because the body sanitizer strips angle-bracket shapes at rest.

## What changed

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `i18n.ts` (new rows only, plus one rewritten hint), one new pin file, one changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell: patch`). The lock predicate `isArtifactBackedLayer` is byte-identical to `main`; no second predicate.

- The locked editor (artifact tier is the deciding gate: `lockedByArtifactTier`) renders **Clone to customize** in the header slot Save would occupy, and a visible guidance line (`role="note"`) that names cloning first. The badge hint `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` is rewritten so cloning comes first and the former remedies (edit the source artifact and redeploy, a new runtime set, `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE`) follow as secondary routes; the server's reason and code stay in it.
- Clicking it runs the server-published `clone_permission_set` record action on `sys_permission_set` through the console's shared action runner (`useAction()`), resolved by name off the object definition the console metadata store holds (`useMetadata().ensureType('object')`), with the set's `sys_permission_set` row (found by `name`, the same lookup `AssignedUsersSection` uses) stashed under `params._rowRecord` and the declared `params` surfaced as `actionParams` — the dispatch shape of `DeclaredActionsBar`. No clone is assembled from create/update calls: an object that publishes no such action, or a set with no row, is a named refusal (`perm.clone.actionMissing`, `perm.clone.rowMissing`).
- On success the routed metadata admin navigates to `../NAME` (`relative: 'path'`, the spelling `ResourceEditPage` uses after create), where the clone loads with no code layer and is writable. An embedded host has no route and gets a `role="status"` notice naming the clone.
- Item 3: a save that still reaches the environment door and is refused `403` with code `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (matched with `errorCodeIs`, never on prose) renders `perm.save.locked` with the same Clone button and keeps the server's sentence underneath, instead of the transport's message alone. Env door only (`!packageId`).

## H1 — the agreement measurement

**Booted showcase: NOT MEASURED.** Blocker, measured in this container: `/home/user/objectstack` has `node_modules` with 0 entries and no `dist` under `packages/spec`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security` or `packages/cli`; objectui's `node_modules/@objectstack` holds only `spec` (17.4.0), no runtime plugin. A showcase boot needs a full objectstack install plus a workspace build under the shared verify lock, which is outside this card's objectui-only file surface and the foreground cap. Not guessed.

**Source-level reading instead** (objectstack `origin/main` at `2bbebf5321`; `sys-permission-set.object.ts` is byte-identical at tag `@objectstack/plugin-security@17.4.0`, `git diff` empty), on the same two inputs:

- Server `isArtifactBacked(type, name)` in `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is true when `lookupArtifactItem(type, name)` answers — artifact items only, the `sys_metadata` rehydration sentinel excluded, plain-key shadows ignored — or when `isNestedArtifactField` does (declared `field`-only, irrelevant to `permission`).
- The layered read's `code` layer is the MetadataService copy when one exists, else `lookupArtifactItem(...) ?? registry.getItem(...)`; a DB-hydrated runtime shadow carries `_packageId: 'sys_metadata'`. Its `provenance` is the item's own `_provenance` stamp (`resolveLockState` → `extractProtection`, `@objectstack/spec` kernel `metadata-protection.zod.ts`).
- Client `isArtifactBackedLayer(lay)` is `code` non-null AND `code._packageId !== 'sys_metadata'` AND `provenance !== 'org'`.
- Case A, a code-package set: server true → `saveMetaItem` refuses the env-door PUT with `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (`allowOrgOverride: false`, when `environmentId` is defined); client `code` carries the package id → locked. Agree.
- Case B, a `sys_metadata`-backed package set (`managed_by: 'package'`, definition only in `sys_metadata`): server `lookupArtifactItem` excludes the sentinel → false → the `allowRuntimeCreate` tier accepts; client `code` is the hydrated shadow with `_packageId: 'sys_metadata'` (or null) → not locked. Agree.
- The data door's `classifyPackagedPermissionSet` (`packaged-permission-set-lock.ts`) decides from the same artifact rule (`declaredPackageIdOf` excludes `_envProjection` echoes and the sentinel), so all three spellings key on one fact.
- Known residue, unchanged (objectui#4526): on a single-kernel host (`environmentId` undefined) the server disengages its artifact tier and accepts; the client still locks. Conservative, previously accepted.

## H2 — how the console invokes a published record action

`clone_permission_set` is `type: 'api'`, `method: 'POST'`, `target: '/api/v1/data/sys_permission_set'`, `bodyExtra: { active: true }`, `params`: `label` and `name` (required text), `description` and the five facets with `defaultFromRow` / `carryOver`. It is not a `script` action, so `serverActionHandler` is not its path: the console dispatches `type: 'api'` through `useConsoleActionRuntime.apiHandler`, registered on the `ActionProvider` that `GlobalActionRuntimeProvider` (ConsoleShell) wraps every route in, with `onParamCollection` seeding `defaultFromRow` params from `params._rowRecord`. The editor uses that same provider via `useAction()`.

What the action returns: **NOT MEASURED** on a live server. By source, the data door answers the spec's `CreateDataResponse` — `{ object, id, record }` — with status 201 (`runtime/src/domains/data.ts`, `CreateDataResponseSchema` in the installed `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`), and `apiHandler` unwraps the `{ success, data }` envelope to `result.data`. The editor reads `result.data.record.name`; when that is absent it says so (`perm.clone.noName`) rather than guessing.

## H3 — strings

All through `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, en-US and zh-CN rows. Rewritten: `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint`. New: `perm.clone.action`, `perm.clone.hint`, `perm.clone.guidance`, `perm.clone.actionMissing`, `perm.clone.rowMissing`, `perm.clone.noName`, `perm.clone.done`, `perm.save.locked`. `check:i18n-designer-parity` and `check:i18n-drift` (designer population) both green.

## H4 — item 3

Measured with the 403 mocked at the data-source boundary (`client.save` rejecting with `status: 403, code: 'NOT_OVERRIDABLE'`). Before: the red strip rendered the transport's message. For the metadata door that message (`saveMetaItem`'s artifact-tier refusal) says to edit the source artifact and redeploy or set `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` — the pre-ruling remedies, never the clone — so it was the generic form. Changed as described above; the pin and its controls are below.

## Pins and ablations

New file `PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize.test.tsx`, 17 tests, real `ActionProvider` with the runtime's three seams faked (api handler, param dialog, toast); adapter and metadata store faked through `@object-ui/react` with `importOriginal` spread.

Red on the base editor plus base i18n (`a2f361b8c1`, the test file kept): `Tests 11 failed | 6 passed (17)` — the 6 that pass on base are the controls (org-owned / sentinel / type-locked / host-locked show no clone prompt; other refusals stay generic), which hold on base by construction. Head: `17 passed`.

Per-hunk ablations, each landed on disk (anchor 1 → 0, replacement present), run, and restored with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`, proven by `git diff HEAD` empty and blob hash equal to HEAD's:

- A header Clone button removed → 8 failed (primary action, zh, dispatch, opens writable, embedded notice, cancel, both no-fallback refusals).
- B item-3 branch removed → 2 failed (NOT_OVERRIDABLE guidance, lowercase-code spelling).
- C en hint with the secondary routes moved before cloning → 1 failed (ordering pin).
- D visible guidance strip removed → 2 failed (primary-action pin, zh).
- E zh `perm.clone.action` row deleted → 1 failed (zh), and `check-i18n-designer-table-parity` exit 1 naming `perm.clone.action`.
- F declared params not surfaced to the runner → 2 failed (dispatch pin, cancel pin).
- G clone not opened after success → 1 failed (opens-writable pin).

## Gates (local; the farm is CI's)

All under the shared verify lock unless noted; verdict lines quoted from the tools.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `PermissionMatrixEditor*`, the metadata-admin i18n pins and `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.readDecorationStrip`: `Test Files 22 passed (22) · Tests 119 passed (119)` after the one selector fix (first run 118/119; the zh pin matched two elements).
- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (script name echoed): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, no `error TS`.
- eslint, narrowed to the three changed files (lock-free): `0 errors, 32 warnings`; population = `eslint .` from `packages/app-shell` under the root flat config; `--format json` counts 3 files; the config sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. Warnings: 31 pre-existing on unchanged lines plus one `catch (err: any)` in the new handler, the spelling `doSave` already uses. `pnpm lint` (repo scan) is CI's.
- Lock-free gates, each exit 0: `check-i18n-designer-table-parity`, `check-i18n-en-drift`, `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-changeset-presence` (`2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed ... declares 1 changeset(s)`), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-unreferenced-sources`, `check-handler-key-read-sites`, `check-object-metadata-write-doors`.
- Not run locally, CI's: `pnpm lint`, the four/eight test shards, `pnpm check` (needs the CLI build).

## Serial

`origin/main` fetched into a private ref (`refs/issue5987/main`, `01700dcd7d`) before the final push: 1 commit since the base `a2f361b8c1`, none touching the changed paths; `git merge-tree --write-tree` against HEAD exits 0. No merge commit needed.

## Acceptance notes

- Observation (objectstack side, not in this PR): the metadata door's artifact-tier refusal text in `saveMetaItem` still names edit-and-redeploy and `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE`, while the data door's `PackagedPermissionSetLockedError` names the Clone action. The Studio editor hits the metadata door, which is why item 3 had to key on the code. Reported in the dev report for the seat, not filed here.
- The 6 control pins pass on base by construction (they assert an absence); the 11 affordance pins are the red-then-green evidence.
- `useAction()` falls back to a bare `ActionRunner` when no `ActionProvider` is mounted (a host that embeds the editor outside `ConsoleShell`); that fallback is the platform's existing shape for every `useAction()` consumer and is not changed here.
- If the typed clone `name` collides with a package-declared set, the data door's insert leg refuses it; that refusal is the published action's own and reaches the user through the runner's error toast, unchanged.
- The single-kernel residue of objectui#4526 is unchanged.
